mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN T.TASK_STATUS_ID = 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS created, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN T.TASK_STATUS_ID = 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inProgress, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN T.TASK_STATUS_ID = 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS done, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN T.TASK_STATUS_ID = 13 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejected, NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN T.DUE_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND T.DUE_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 4 AND T.TASK_STATUS_ID NOT IN (13, 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS deadline FROM TASKS T WHERE T.ASSIGNEE_USER_ID = #{userId}
